```sql
WITH entity1 AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.330871 47.604539)'), 4326)::geography AS geom,
    'Sky View Observatory, Seattle, WA' AS name
),
high_elevation_area AS (
  SELECT 
    rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(
      rast,
      ST_Buffer(ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.330871 47.604539)'), 4326), 3500)::geography
    )
    AND ST_Value(rast, 1) >= 1400
),
attractions_in_range AS (
  SELECT 
    p.poi_name,
    p.addr_city,
    p.addr_state,
    ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, entity1.geom) AS distance_meters
  FROM 
    pois p,
    entity1
  WHERE 
    p.addr_state = 'WA'
    AND ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, entity1.geom) <= 3500
    AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT ST_Union(rast) FROM high_elevation_area))
)
SELECT 
  poi_name,
  addr_city,
  addr_state,
  distance_meters
FROM 
  attractions_in_range;
```
